# Nuclei

`nuclei` &middot; _vulnerability-analysis_

Runs a large community template library to detect known vulnerabilities and exposures.

**Moderate impact.** It touches the target directly; keep the scope tight.

## What this tool needs

- A target URL or host in scope.
- The template library (downloaded on first run; needs internet).
- Installed on demand from the Kali repository.

## How to use it

Nuclei matches targets against YAML templates. Start with a tag filter (e.g. `-tags cve`) so a scan finishes quickly, then widen. Read the template names to understand what each check does.

## Examples

```console
$ nuclei -u https://example.com -tags cve
$ nuclei -u https://example.com -severity high,critical
```

## At a glance

- Category: `vulnerability-analysis`
- Install with: `apt install nuclei`
- Baseline: no
- Licence: MIT
- Upstream: <https://github.com/projectdiscovery/nuclei>
